### Libraries, directories and functions
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(vcd)
library(caret)

row_mode <- function(x, tie_method = c("min", "max", "random")) {
  set.seed(123)
  tie_method <- match.arg(tie_method)
  x <- na.omit(x)
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA)
  tab <- table(x)
  modes <- as.numeric(names(tab)[tab == max(tab)])
  if (length(modes) == 1) {
    return(modes)
  } else {
    if (tie_method == "min") {
      return(min(modes))
    } else if (tie_method == "max") {
      return(max(modes))
    } else if (tie_method == "random") {
      return(sample(modes, 1))
    }
  }
}

calculate_agreement <- function(df,
                             observers,
                             levels = 0:3,
                             weight_types = c("Equal-Spacing", "Fleiss-Cohen")) {
 
  #—helper to build summary for a single pair—
  pair_summary <- function(o1, o2) {
    # contingency table
    tab <- xtabs(~ factor(df[[o1]], levels = levels) +
                   factor(df[[o2]], levels = levels))
    
    n   <- sum(tab)
    p_o <- sum(diag(tab)) / n
    
    k   <- Kappa(tab, weight = weight_types)
    ci  <- confint(k)      # length-4 vector: unweighted low/up, weighted low/up
    
    data.frame(
      path_pair             = paste(o1, "vs", o2),
      total_n               = n,
      observed_agreement    = p_o,
      cohens_kappa          = k$Unweighted[1],
      cohens_kappa_SE       = k$Unweighted[2],
      cohens_kappa_MoE      = (ci[3] - ci[1]) / 2,
      cohens_kappa_CI_lwr   = ci[1],
      cohens_kappa_CI_upr   = ci[3],
      cohens_kappa_sd       = k$Unweighted[2] * sqrt(n),
      weighted_kappa        = k$Weighted[1],
      weighted_kappa_SE     = k$Weighted[2],
      weighted_kappa_MoE    = (ci[4] - ci[2]) / 2,
      weighted_kappa_CI_lwr = ci[2],
      weighted_kappa_CI_upr = ci[4],
      weighted_kappa_sd     = k$Weighted[2] * sqrt(n)
    )
  }
  
  #—all observer pairs—
  pairs <- combn(observers, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  #—bind all summaries—
  agreement_frame <- map_dfr(pairs, ~ pair_summary(.x[1], .x[2])) %>% 
    select(path_pair, everything())
  
  return(agreement_frame)
}


# Helper function
get_kappa_summary <- function(df, name) {
  
  # Determine type
  if (str_ends(name, "cellularity") | str_ends(name, "size")) {
    type <- "ordinal"
    kappa_type <- "weighted_linear"
    kappa_col <- "weighted_kappa"
    ag_col <- "observed_agreement"
  } else {
    type <- "binary"
    kappa_type <- "cohens"
    kappa_col <- "cohens_kappa"
    ag_col <- "observed_agreement"
  }
  
  # Defensive: handle missing columns gracefully
  if (!(kappa_col %in% colnames(df))) {
    median_agreement <- NA
    iqr_agreement <- NA
    median_kappa <- NA
    iqr_kappa <- NA
  } else {
    agreement_vals <- df[[ag_col]]
    kappa_vals <- df[[kappa_col]]
    median_agreement <- median(agreement_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    iqr_agreement <- IQR(agreement_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    median_kappa <- median(kappa_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    iqr_kappa <- IQR(kappa_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  tibble(
    variable = name,
    type = type,
    median_agreement = median_agreement,
    iqr_agreement = iqr_agreement,
    kappa_type = kappa_type,
    median_kappa = median_kappa,
    iqr_kappa = iqr_kappa
  )
}


plot_agreement <- function(df, 
                           type = c("binary", "ordinal", "size"), 
                           variable_name = "Variable", 
                           output_dir = "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/pathologists_reproducibility/") {
  # Choose palette and labels based on type
  type <- match.arg(type)
  if (type == "binary") {
    palette <- c("#FDE0C2", "#7F2704")
    fill_labels <- c("0" = "Absent", "1" = "Present")
  } else if (type == "ordinal") {
    palette <- c("#FDE0C2", "#FDBE85", "#FA8533", "#7F2704")
    fill_labels <- c("0" = "Normal", "1" = "Mild", "2" = "Moderate", "3" = "Marked")
  } else if (type == "size") {
    palette <- c("#FDBE85", "#FA8533", "#7F2704")
    fill_labels <- c("1" = "Small", "2" = "Intermediate", "3" = "Large")
  }
  # Compute column sums (excluding first column)
  column_sums <- colSums(df[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
  pathologist_order <- data.frame(variable = names(column_sums), column_sum = column_sums)
  pathologist_order <- arrange(pathologist_order, column_sum)
  ordered_pathologists <- pathologist_order$variable
  
  # Compute row sums for ordering
  df$sum <- rowSums(df[, -1], na.rm = TRUE)
  df <- df %>% arrange(desc(sum))
  
  # Long format for plotting
  df_long <- pivot_longer(df, cols = starts_with("p"), names_to = "Pathologist", values_to = "Grade")
  df_long$name <- factor(df_long$name, levels = unique(df$name))
  
  plot <- ggplot(df_long, 
                 aes(x = factor(Pathologist, levels = ordered_pathologists), 
                     y = name, 
                     fill = factor(Grade))) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, name = "Grade", labels = fill_labels) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right", 
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9, family = "Arial"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Pathologist",
      y = "Mucosal segment",
      title = variable_name
    )
  
  var <- tolower(variable_name)
  var <- gsub(" |-", "_", var)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, var, "_agreement_plot.png"),   # change as needed
    plot     = plot,
    width    = 7, 
    height   = 7,     
    units    = "in",
    dpi      = 300 ) 
  
  return(plot)
}

```

```{r}
mucosa_grade_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/input/"

id_map <- 
c("qv" = "p12",
  "pe" = "p13", 
  "aog" = "p14")

files <- list.files(
  path = mucosa_grade_dir,
  pattern = "_quality\\.xlsx$",   # any …_grading_sample.xlsx
  ignore.case = TRUE,                    # be lenient about case
  full.names = TRUE                      # keep the path if not in wd

get_initials <- function(fname) tolower(str_extract(basename(fname), "^[^_]+"))

grading_list <- set_names(files, get_initials(files)) |>
  imap(~ {
    df <- read_excel(.x)
    initials <- .y
    deid     <- id_map[initials]

    if (is.na(deid)) {
      warning(sprintf("No mapping for initials \"%s\" – keeping original ID", initials))
      deid <- initials       # fallback: keep initials if unmapped
    }

    df |>
      select(name:artefact_crypts) %>%
      mutate(pathologist_id = deid)       # or rename/relocate as you wish
  }) |>
  set_names(~ id_map[.])                  # list names == new IDs

long_tbl <- bind_rows(grading_list, .id = "pathologist_id")
grading_vars <- setdiff(names(long_tbl), c("name", "pathologist_id"))

id_levels <- sprintf("p%02d", 12:14)
long_tbl  <- long_tbl %>%
  mutate(pathologist_id = factor(pathologist_id, levels = id_levels))

table_s3 <- readxl::read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/output/parse_path_report/wsi_info_table_s3_2026-10-10.xlsx")

pathologist_grading_set <- table_s3 %>% filter(pathologist_grading_set)

long_tbl <- long_tbl %>% 
  mutate(image_name = sub("_[^_]*_[^_]*$", "", name)) %>%
  filter(image_name %in% pathologist_grading_set$image_name)
```

```{r}

variable_frames <- map(
  grading_vars,
  \(var) {
    long_tbl %>%
      select(name, pathologist_id, !!sym(var)) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from  = pathologist_id,
        values_from = !!sym(var)
      ) %>%
      arrange(name)
  }
) |>
  set_names(grading_vars)   # list names = sheet names

id_cols <- sprintf("p%02d", 12:14)   

variable_frames <- map(variable_frames, \(df) {
  df %>%
    select(name, any_of(id_cols))     # keeps only the IDs that exist,
                                      # in the specified order
})

value_map <- c(
  absent        = 0,
  adequate         = 1, present       = 1, 
  marginal     = 2, 
  inadequate       = 3, 
  nonassessable = NA_real_         )

variable_frames_num <- map(variable_frames, \(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(across(
      -name,                                      
      ~ value_map[str_trim(tolower(as.character(.x)))]
    ))
})

majority_grades_mode <- map_dfc(variable_frames_num, ~{
  df <- .
  df %>%
    mutate(mode_grade = apply(select(., starts_with("p")), 1, row_mode, tie_method = "min")) %>%
    select(name, mode_grade)
}) %>%
  {
    result <- .
    names_col <- result %>% select(starts_with("name")) %>% pull(1)
    grade_cols <- result %>% select(contains("mode_grade"))
    colnames(grade_cols) <- names(variable_frames_num)
    cbind(name = names_col, grade_cols)
  }

write_json(majority_grades_mode, paste0(output_dir, "majority_grades.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```

```{r}
majority_grades_mode <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "majority_grades.json"))
grades_summary <- majority_grades_mode %>%
  pivot_longer(-name, names_to = "variable", values_to = "grade") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_0   = mean(grade == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_1   = mean(grade == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_2   = mean(grade == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_3   = mean(grade == 3, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

grades_summary <- grades_summary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    min_max_ratio = {
      vals <- c_across(starts_with("pct"))
      # Exclude zeros
      vals_nonzero <- vals[vals != 0]
      if(length(vals_nonzero) == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        min(vals_nonzero, na.rm = TRUE) / max(vals_nonzero, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(pct_0 = ifelse(pct_0 == 0, NA_real_, pct_0),
         pct_1 = ifelse(pct_1 == 0, NA_real_, pct_1),
         pct_2 = ifelse(pct_2 == 0, NA_real_ , pct_2),
         pct_3 = ifelse(pct_3 == 0, NA_real_, pct_3)
         )

variables <- names(variable_frames_num)

agreement_frames <- imap(          # i = element value (df), .y = element name (var)
  variable_frames_num,
  ~{
    observers <- names(.x)[-1]
    calculate_agreement(.x, observers)
  }
)

kappa_summary <- map2_dfr(agreement_frames, names(agreement_frames), get_kappa_summary)




kappa_summary <- grades_summary %>% left_join(kappa_summary) %>%
  mutate(kappa_type = ifelse(min_max_ratio <0.2, NA_real_, kappa_type),
         median_kappa = ifelse(min_max_ratio <0.2, NA_real_, median_kappa),
         iqr_kappa = ifelse(min_max_ratio <0.2, NA_real_, iqr_kappa)
         )

kappa_summary_for_pub <- kappa_summary %>%
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "artefact_crypts" ~ "Artefact\ncrypts",
    variable == "artefact_villi" ~ "Artefact\nvilli",
    variable == "orientation" ~ "Orientation",
    variable == "small_intestinal_mucosa"  ~"Small intestinal mucosa",
    TRUE ~ variable)) %>%
  rename(`Graded quality feature` = variable,
         `0 (%)` = pct_0,
         `1 (%)` = pct_1,
         `2 (%)` = pct_2,
         `3 (%)` = pct_3,
         `Min-max ratio` = min_max_ratio,
         `Variable type` = type,
         `Kappa (type)` = kappa_type) %>%
   mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  mutate(`Kappa (median, IQR)` = paste0(median_kappa, " (", 
                                        median_kappa - (iqr_kappa/2), "-",
                                        median_kappa + (iqr_kappa/2), ")"),
         `Kappa (median, IQR)`= ifelse(`Kappa (median, IQR)` == "NA (NA-NA)", NA_real_, `Kappa (median, IQR)`),
         `Agreement (median, IQR)` = paste0(median_agreement, " (", 
                                            median_agreement - (iqr_agreement/2), "-",
                                            median_agreement + (iqr_agreement/2), ")"),
         across(ends_with("(%)"), ~ round(.x * 100, 1))) %>%
  select(`Graded quality feature`, 
         `0 (%)`, 
         `1 (%)`,
         `2 (%)`,
         `3 (%)`,
         `Min-max ratio`,
         `Agreement (median, IQR)`,
         `Kappa (median, IQR)`
         )  %>%
  arrange(desc(`Graded quality feature`))
         
         
write_xlsx(kappa_summary_for_pub, paste0(output_dir, "agreement_summary_table_new.xlsx"))
```

## Validation
```{r}

mucosa_grade_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/input/"
output_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa_validation/"

majority_grades <- fromJSON(paste0(output_dir, "majority_grades.json")) %>%
  mutate(artefact = case_when(artefact_villi == 3 | artefact_crypts == 3 ~ 3,
                              artefact_villi == 2 | artefact_crypts == 2 ~ 2,
                              artefact_villi == 1 | artefact_crypts == 1 ~ 1,
                              TRUE ~ NA_real_
                              )) %>%
  select(name, small_intestinal_mucosa, orientation, artefact)

ai <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/mucosa_list_all.json") %>% 
  filter(name %in% majority_grades$name) %>% 
  mutate(
    small_intestinal_mucosa = case_when(
      classification == "no_mucosa" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ 1),
    orientation = case_when(orientation_class == "adequate" ~ 1,
                            orientation_class == "marginal" ~ 2,
                            orientation_class == "inadequate" ~ 3,
                            TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    artefact = case_when(artefact_class == "adequate" ~ 1,
                         artefact_class == "marginal" ~ 2,
                         artefact_class == "inadequate" ~ 3)) %>%
  select(name, small_intestinal_mucosa, orientation, artefact)




library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# 1. Join dataframes by 'name'
comparison_df <- majority_grades %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_ref"), -name) %>%
  inner_join(ai %>% rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_ai"), -name), by = "name")

# 2. Variables to assess
vars <- c("small_intestinal_mucosa", "orientation", "artefact")

# 3. Metric calculation function
compute_metrics <- function(var) {
  ref <- comparison_df[[paste0(var, "_ref")]]
  pred <- comparison_df[[paste0(var, "_ai")]]

  # Drop any rows where either is NA
  valid_idx <- !(is.na(ref) | is.na(pred))
  ref <- ref[valid_idx]
  pred <- pred[valid_idx]

  # Skip if nothing to compare
  if (length(ref) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Get all unique levels across both
  levels_all <- sort(union(unique(ref), unique(pred)))
  ref <- factor(ref, levels = levels_all)
  pred <- factor(pred, levels = levels_all)

  map_dfr(levels_all, function(lvl) {
    TP <- sum(ref == lvl & pred == lvl, na.rm = TRUE)
    FP <- sum(ref != lvl & pred == lvl, na.rm = TRUE)
    FN <- sum(ref == lvl & pred != lvl, na.rm = TRUE)
    TN <- sum(ref != lvl & pred != lvl, na.rm = TRUE)

    sensitivity <- if ((TP + FN) > 0) TP / (TP + FN) else NA_real_
    specificity <- if ((TN + FP) > 0) TN / (TN + FP) else NA_real_
    ppv         <- if ((TP + FP) > 0) TP / (TP + FP) else NA_real_
    npv         <- if ((TN + FN) > 0) TN / (TN + FN) else NA_real_
    accuracy    <- if ((TP + TN + FP + FN) > 0) (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN) else NA_real_
    balanced_accuracy <- if (!is.na(sensitivity) && !is.na(specificity)) {
      (sensitivity + specificity) / 2
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    f1 <- if (!is.na(sensitivity) && !is.na(ppv) && (sensitivity + ppv) > 0) {
      2 * sensitivity * ppv / (sensitivity + ppv)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    tibble(
      variable = var,
      class = lvl,
      sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
      specificity = round(specificity, 3),
      ppv = round(ppv, 3),
      npv = round(npv, 3),
      accuracy = round(accuracy, 3),
      balanced_accuracy = round(balanced_accuracy, 3),
      f1_score = round(f1, 3)
    )
  })
}

# 4. Run for all variables
all_metrics <- map_dfr(vars, compute_metrics)

# 5. View results
print(all_metrics)

#write_json(comparison_df, paste0(output_dir, "mucosa_ai_and_ref.json"), pretty = TRUE)
write_json(all_metrics, paste0(output_dir, "mucosa_validation_metrics.json"), pretty = TRUE)
```

### Calculate metrics specifically for detecting segments eligble for inclusion 
(small intestinal mucosa - not inadeqauate orientaiton or artefact)
```{r}
template <- comparison_df %>%
  mutate(tp = case_when(
    small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 1 & orientation_ref != 3 & artefact_ref != 3 &
    small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 1 & orientation_ai != 3 & artefact_ai != 3 ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE),
    fp = case_when(
      (small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 0  | orientation_ref == 3 | artefact_ref == 3) &
        small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 1 & orientation_ai != 3 & artefact_ai != 3 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    tn = case_when(
      (small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 0 | orientation_ref == 3 |  artefact_ref == 3) &
        (small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 0 | orientation_ai == 3 | artefact_ai == 3) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    fn = case_when(
      (small_intestinal_mucosa_ref == 1 & orientation_ref != 3 & artefact_ref != 3) &
        (small_intestinal_mucosa_ai == 0 | orientation_ai == 3 | artefact_ai == 3) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE))

summary_df <- template %>%
  summarise(
    tp = sum(tp),
    fp = sum(fp),
    tn = sum(tn),
    fn = sum(fn)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp),
    ppv = tp / (tp + fp),
    npv = tn / (tn + fn),
    accuracy = (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn),
    balanced_accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity) / 2,
    f1 = 2 * ppv * sensitivity / (ppv + sensitivity)
  )

writexl::write_xlxs(template, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/")
```
